source_scope: Completed matches within the requested competition and season; existing source-availability season gate retained.
pair_eligibility: Numerator and attempted-pass denominator must be present finite nonnegative integer counts from the same player-match, with numerator no greater than denominator.
value: 100 * sum(eligible numerators) / sum(the same eligible denominators); zero or absent denominator gives null, never a measured zero.
incomplete_inputs: Exclude incomplete pairs and report incomplete_paired_inputs; preserve all original rows.
invalid_inputs: Exclude invalid pairs with an explicit issue; never clip a percentage to 100.
input_matches: Count of input matches used by the declared method. This replaces the ambiguous paired_matches response name.
unchanged_metrics: Other approved player ratio definitions retain v1 independent_available_sums, explicit source-version checks and their own input match counts.
history_policy: Read-only v2 projection. Do not overwrite v1 materializations or prediction history.
